input.quote: This Agreement including all Exhibits, and the Non Disclosure Agreement and the Statement of Work referenced in this Agreement and incorporated by reference herein, constitutes the final, complete and exclusive agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, and supersedes any prior or contemporaneous agreement.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "induce" and "recruit" return no hiring restriction anywhere in the Agreement. The Miscellaneous section (14.1–14.10) contains no restrictive covenant, Section 10 (Confidentiality) is limited to use of Confidential Information under the separate NDA, and the only personnel-related provisions — Section 13 (Shared Resources, which addresses Employee NDA/Invention Agreements and ownership of Developments) and Exhibit D, Section 5 (each party assigning a sales/marketing employee) — impose no non-solicitation or no-hire obligation on Corio. The integration clause confirms no other document within the four corners imposes such a covenant. This meets the preferred position (no non-solicit binding the Customer), so no redline is warranted; the absence of any restriction benefits us.
